maya: Heads-up — p99 for /v1/generate jumped from ~380ms -> ~1.1s on the latency dashboard after last night's routing policy tweak :eyes:
liam: saw that, yup. Is it isolated to one endpoint or across the bundle?
sarah: looks like /v1/generate + /v1/stream show the biggest delta when we aggregate by endpoint. Individual node traces look fine.
maya: hmm. hypothesis: collection window / bucketing change we rolled in the console might be merging short-lived async timings into the tail.
ajay: can you paste the dashboard query? maybe the rollup window switched from 1s->10s and tdigest merge behavior is different.
maya: here's what the console uses atm (copied from panels):
```
SELECT tdigest_merge(latency_tdigest) AS latency_td FROM endpoint_rollups WHERE endpoint = '/v1/generate' AND time >= now() - 1h GROUP BY time(1m)
```
liam: ok that is tdigest_merge on 1m buckets. If samples are bursty and we moved the ingestion window, merging heavier buckets could inflate p99.
sarah: also noticed we changed bucket boundaries (histogram) in the artifact: bucket upper bounds now end at 512ms instead of 500ms. tiny shifts like that change interpolation in the UI percentile calc.
ajay: oh right — if UI falls back to histogram interpolation for sparse bins, that boundary shift will nudge p95/p99.
console-bot: Deploy bot: routing-policy-v2 was rolled at 2024-11-03T02:13Z by ci/cd. No failed checks. :white_check_mark:
liam: can we reproduce locally by simulating bursty traffic + 1m vs 10s rollup? I can run a quick headless job.
maya: yes please. Also, UX question: can the console show "percentile provenance" (raw-samples vs tdigest vs histogram-interp) in hover? right now it's opaque and people assume p99 = raw.
sarah: +1 — for rollout gating we need to know if p99 jump is real or an aggregation artifact. otherwise we gate on noise.
ajay: temporary mitigation: add an annotation on dashboards when rollup window or histogram bucket config changes. That would help correlate.
liam: I spun a replay job (short burst + kvcache misses) — reproduces a ~2x p99 bump when switching rollup from 10s->1m and using tdigest_merge. raw quantiles (from collected samples) stay flat.
maya: great catch. So root cause = aggregation window + tdigest merge sensitivity + bucket boundary drift. Not a routing algorithm perf regression.
sarah: next steps?
ajay: short-term: annotate the dashboard and revert bucket boundary change to previous config. medium: expose provenance in hover and add a small note in rollout gating UI that warns on recent aggregation config changes.
liam: I'll open a PR for a revert + test replay harness to prevent accidental bucket changes.
maya: thanks — can someone add the console annotation now? even a manual note will help support triage.
sarah: I'll add it and file the backend tickets for provenance metadata.
maya: perfect. closing loop once PR is merged. :thumbsup:
thread_summary: Discussion identifying a p99 spike as an aggregation artifact caused by rollup window change + tdigest merge + histogram bucket boundary drift; actions: reproduce, revert bucket change, annotate dashboard, add provenance hover and gating warning.
